splits.customers: 70% train / 15% validation / 15% test, by customer (seeded), the same split for every model
splits.merchants: 20% of merchants never appear in training (categoriser generalisation)

impact_truth_recovery.note: Engine inputs read from transactions at the 31 March 2026 snapshot vs the simulator's true annual usage. Only customers whose spend is visible (fuel bought on our cards, energy bills paid from our accounts).

backtest.note: held-out test customers, training snapshot (31 Mar 2026), take-up observed 1 Apr 2026 - 30 Sep 2026; same number contacted per product by each strategy

measured_uplift.note: held-out test customers selected by the model on 31 Mar 2026, 10% held back at random, openings from the product system 1 Apr 2026 - 30 Sep 2026; the simulator gives contacts no causal effect, so the true uplift is zero
